messages:
oliver: Hi @people-ops — filing for parental leave for an international adoption. Child placement expected around 2026-09-15. What are the docs and timelines, and do we handle payroll differently for folks on an EU contract?

mira (People Ops): Congrats, Oliver! :tada: Key steps: 1) Open a leave request in the HR portal and select 'adoption' 2) Upload placement paperwork within 30 days of placement 3) If you're on an EU contract, we need local compliance forms — please attach passport/visa copies if applicable. Payroll timing: upload ahead of the monthly payroll cutoff to avoid delays.

oliver: Is there any special reimbursement (travel/legal) process for adoption-related expenses?

mira (People Ops): Redwood has an adoption assistance stipend; submit expense receipts via expense.redwood.example with the "adoption" category. There is a separate pre-approval form for travel over $1,000 — DM me and I'll route it to finance.

julia: Team coverage note: we can hire a 3-month contractor to cover core tasks. @recruiting-bot can you create a short req for a contract SWE with 6+ months exp and immediate start?

recruiting-bot: New req created: contractor-swe-temp-3mo. Hiring lead julia. Link: https://recruiting.redwood.example/req/4582

oliver: Amazing — thanks. Mira: will I keep benefits while on adoption leave?

mira (People Ops): Yes, benefits continue during approved leave. If you travel outside your home country, check the health plan network and let Benefits know if you need international coverage. Also note: time off and statutory entitlements vary by country; People Ops will send a country-specific summary after you submit the portal request.

people-ops-bot: reminder: "Upload placement docs and passport/visa copies to the HR portal. Payroll cutoff for September: 2026-09-01."

julia: I'll coordinate the contractor onboarding and runbooks. Oliver — can you list 3 critical deliverables and any access needed in the coverage plan box?

oliver: Will do. Also requesting a phased return (80% for 4w). How do we record that?

mira (People Ops): Add "phased return: 80% for 4 weeks" in the notes when you file. Manager approval required; People Ops will add a return checklist and calendar reminder 2 weeks before the projected RTW.

oliver: Great — filing now and will DM the payroll case number. Thanks everyone :heart:
